# Lux IPTV - Initial Specification
# Generated by sdd-init on 2026-08-23

project: iptv
version: "0.1.0"
status: "initialized"

## Core Modules

### 1. Desktop Shell (Electron)
- Main process: Window management, HWID extraction, license validation
- Preload script: Secure IPC bridge via contextBridge
- Renderer: React application with 10-Foot UI

### 2. Frontend Application (React + Tailwind)
- Profile management (CU-01)
- Content discovery and navigation
- Video player with OSD (CU-04)
- EPG guide and zapping (CU-05)
- Global search (CU-06)
- Settings and parental control (CU-03)

### 3. Data Layer (IndexedDB + OPFS)
- Content storage (live, movies, series)
- Profile isolation
- Enrichment cache (TMDB)
- Image cache (OPFS)

### 4. Ingestion Pipeline (Web Workers)
- M3U/M3U8 parsing (iptv-m3u-playlist-parser)
- XMLTV/EPG parsing (@iptv/xmltv)
- Content classification heuristics (6-stage)
- TMDB metadata enrichment

### 5. Video Player (hls.js)
- HLS/DASH/TS stream support
- Error recovery and resilience
- Audio/subtitle track selection
- Aspect ratio control

### 6. Licensing Backend (Fastify + PostgreSQL)
- HWID-based license validation
- Trial mode management
- User license activation
- API key management

### 7. UI Design System (Stitch)
- Cinematic Glass theme
- 11 screens (8 documented + 3 additional)
- D-Pad navigation
- Safe area compliance

## Data Flow

```
User Input → Electron Main → IPC Bridge → React UI
                    ↓
            Web Worker (Ingestion)
                    ↓
            IndexedDB (Content)
                    ↓
            React UI (Display)
                    ↓
            hls.js (Playback)
```

## Testing Strategy

- Unit tests: Vitest (80% coverage threshold)
- Integration tests: Vitest + MSW
- E2E tests: Playwright + Electron
- Performance tests: Custom metrics (FPS, latency, memory)
- Security tests: Parental control, license validation

## Deployment

- Development: Docker Compose (local)
- Production: PM2 + nginx + Let's Encrypt (Hostinger VPS)
- Desktop: Electron builder (Windows, macOS, Linux)
